images.filename: Female engagement event during Cooperation Afloat Readiness and Training (CARAT) Brunei 2011 in Muara, Brunei, 4 Oct. 2011, 111004-N-KK935-024 (6214715572).jpg
images.caption: U.S. Navy Chief Fire Controlman Sandra Valdez, left, and Fire Controlman Tanysha Brown, both assigned to the guided missile destroyer USS Dewey (DDG 105), speak with a Royal Brunei Navy officer during a female engagement event during Cooperation Afloat Readiness and Training (CARAT) Brunei 2011 in Muara, Brunei, 4 Oct. 2011.  CARAT is a series of bilateral exercises held annually in south-east Asia to strengthen relationships and to enhance force readiness.  (DoD photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Jessica Bidwell, U.S. Navy/Released)
images.alt: U.S. Navy Chief Fire Controlman Sandra Valdez, left, and Fire Controlman Tanysha Brown, both assigned to the guided missile destroyer USS Dewey (DDG 105), speak with a Royal Brunei Navy officer during a female engagement event during Cooperation Afloat Readiness and Training (CARAT) Brunei 2011 in Muara, Brunei, 4 Oct. 2011.  CARAT is a series of bilateral exercises held annually in south-east Asia to strengthen relationships and to enhance force readiness.  (DoD photo by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Jessica Bidwell, U.S. Navy/Released)

images.filename: Commander of the Royal Brunei Armed Forces (RBAF - ABDB), Pehin Datu Pekerma Jaya Major General Dato Paduka Seri Mohd Tawih Abdullah, 160503-N-OU129-179.jpg
images.caption: 160503-N-OU129-179  Muara Naval Base, Brunei (3 May 2016) - Commander of the Royal Brunei Armed Forces (RBAF / ABDB), Pehin Datu Pekerma Jaya Major General Dato Paduka Seri Mohd Tawih Abdullah during the opening ceremony of the ASEAN Defence Minister's Meeting (ADMM) Plus Maritime Security and Counterterrorism Field Training Exercise 2016 May 3.  ADMM Plus aims to enhance cooperation and information sharing during maritime security and counterterrorism operations.  (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 3rd Class Joshua Fulton/Released)

images.filename: Royal Brunei Navy at Muara Naval Base, April 2025 01.jpg
images.caption: The bulk of the Royal Brunei Navy at Muara Naval Base: Three Darussalam-class offshore patrol vessels are on the left, the KDB Darulaman and the KDB Darussalam as well as a third, unidentified ship of the class. In the centre, two Fearless-class patrol vessels can be seen. On the right, two Ijtihad-class patrol boats can be seen, the KDB Syafaat and the KDB Afiat.
